summary: Adds an email search filter to the users index, a self-service profile update, an unguarded user delete, and a welcome email callback on save.

findings.title: SQL injection in email search
findings.problem: The index action interpolates params[:q] directly into the where SQL fragment. A quote in q breaks out of the LIKE literal.
findings.consequence: Any authenticated user can run arbitrary SQL against the users table. That user can read api_token values or change rows.
findings.fix: Pass q as a bound parameter and escape LIKE wildcards with sanitize_sql_like.

findings.title: Destroy action exempted from admin check
findings.problem: The change adds destroy to the require_admin except list. The destroy action then deletes any user by id without an ownership check.
findings.consequence: Any authenticated user can delete every other account, including admins.
findings.fix: Keep destroy behind require_admin by removing it from the except list.

findings.title: Mass assignment of all user attributes in profile
findings.problem: The profile action permits every user param without a whitelist, so it accepts every column. A user can set admin and api_token on their own record.
findings.consequence: Any authenticated user can grant themselves admin rights. That user then gains access to all admin actions.
findings.fix: Permit only the fields a user may edit, such as email.

findings.title: Welcome email sent on every save
findings.problem: The User model runs send_welcome_email after every save, including updates. Each profile update and token change sends another welcome email.
findings.consequence: Existing users receive repeated welcome emails on every update. Users and mail deliverability suffer.
findings.fix: Run the callback only after the record is created.

findings.title: New controller actions have no tests
findings.problem: The repository has no test files covering the new profile and destroy actions or the search filter. The welcome email callback is also untested.
findings.consequence: Authorization and injection regressions in these actions can ship unnoticed.
findings.fix: Add request tests for search, profile, and destroy, including non-admin access.
